hero.title: Junior PHP / Laravel Developer
hero.tagline: PHP solutions for business, with an SEO mindset from day one.
hero.about: My name is Oleksandr Harazha, and I am 22 years old. I love writing vanilla PHP, and I like building with Laravel. To learn about me as a vanilla PHP developer, please read my [“Vanilla Core”](https://github.com/devalexmuha/vanilla-framework) MVC framework, which I built with love, on purpose, to see how a backend works from the inside, at a low level. To learn about me as a Laravel developer, please read my [“Thirteen Flies”](https://github.com/devalexmuha/thirteenflies), a fully-fledged e-commerce API with Filament as the admin panel and Stripe Checkout integration.

canDo.title: What I can do
paragraphs: I build backend PHP solutions for businesses, from new projects to supporting and fixing legacy code. I can also work with WordPress when a project needs it, but for efficiency, I love and prefer Laravel.
I use Laravel for anything that needs complexity: an e-commerce store, a hotel website with a booking system, an online school, etc. Building these feels like art to me.
Additionally, with my experience in SEO, I can advise during development on what will work for search engines and what is better to fix now, before it becomes a problem after launch.

items.title: Poltava Polytechnic Professional College, a Separated Structural Unit of National Technical University "Kharkiv Polytechnic Institute"
Upper Junior SEO Specialist
items.text: With 2 years of experience in the marketing industry as an upper junior SEO specialist, I found myself doing a lot of content placement work, and doing it well. So one year ago, I took the courage to meet my childhood dream of becoming a software engineer face to face, and opened up an entirely new form of art for myself. With the help of experienced developers at my company, after 4 months of thinking as a frontend developer, I became keenly interested in backend development. It’s already been 9 months since I started with PHP. Currently, I want to strengthen my frontend skills and move in the direction of full stack.

items.title: Trainee PHP Backend Developer
items.text: Thanks to the development team at my company, I was given the opportunity to get my first commercial experience and learn how to work with Git in a team. Currently, I’m helping with the development of a Laravel e-commerce store: [infrost.com.ua](https://infrost.com.ua/)

match.title: We are a perfect match if
items: You already have experienced developers, your business is growing, and your team needs help.
In the near future you’ll need a full-stack developer, but for now you’re happy to hire a backend developer.
Communication in your team happens in English.
match.extra: I’m used to working in a friendly environment, in a team where you can speak to the company owner like to a close friend. I’ll be happy to find a team like this again.
